data.reportText: Valero Energy Corporation Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on  10/22/2026 before market open.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  6 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $18.09.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $3.66.
data.heading: VLO Earnings Date

text: VLO has a "high" Earnings Quality Ranking (EQR) for the 167th consecutive week. Earnings quality refers to the extent to which current earnings predict future earnings. "High-quality" earnings are expected to persist, while "low-quality" earnings do not. EQR is a weekly ranking of relative earnings quality for a large universe of publicly traded US equities. Companies are compared to peers in their industry. Find out more about EQR data.
